n = int(input())
m = int(input())
p = int(input())

MAXN = 510

c = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
f = [0] * MAXN
g = [0] * MAXN

dp = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
ways = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
dp2 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
ways2 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
dp0 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
ways0 = [[0] * MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]

def combine(x, y):
    return (x + y) % p

def choose(x):
    return (x * (x - 1) // 2) % p

# Initialize binomial coefficients
for i in range(MAXN):
    c[i][0] = 1
for i in range(1, MAXN):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j]) % p

# Compute f and g
f[0] = 0
g[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        valA = c[i - 1][j - 1] * f[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
        valB = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * f[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
        f[i] = combine(f[i], combine(valA, valB))
        temp = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
        g[i] = combine(g[i], temp)

# Initialize dp and ways
dp[0][0] = 0
ways[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(MAXN):
        for k in range(MAXN):
            dp2[j][k] = 0
            ways2[j][k] = 0
    for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
        for k in range(min(j, m) + 1):
            if k == 0:
                dp0[i][j] = dp[j][0]
                ways0[i][j] = ways[j][0]
            # Update dp2 and ways2
            dp2[j][0] = combine(dp2[j][0], dp[j][k])
            ways2[j][0] = combine(ways2[j][0], ways[j][k])
            rem = m - (j - k)
            if rem >= 0:
                ways2[j + 1][k + 1] = combine(ways2[j + 1][k + 1], ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p)
                dp2[j + 1][k + 1] = combine(dp2[j + 1][k + 1], (dp0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p + ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * f[k + 1] % p))
    for j in range(MAXN):
        for k in range(MAXN):
            dp[j][k] = dp2[j][k]
            ways[j][k] = ways2[j][k]

total = 0
for i in range(m + 1):
    total = combine(total, dp[m][i])

print(total)
